scenario.task_instruction: Handle this synthetic discharge-medication workflow using the available records, messages, procedures, and tools. Decide independently which information and actions are relevant. You may call finish whenever you consider the case resolved.

metadata.task_goal: Establish a current documented disposition for an antiepileptic discharge medication list using the current admission record, outpatient history, and medication evidence.

files./workspace/ehr/request.txt:
DISCHARGE REQUEST
Patient ID: PAT-V3-2001
The neurology service requests a discharge medication list for a patient admitted after breakthrough seizures. The reconciliation reference is DC-V3-2001.
files./workspace/ehr/current_record.txt:
CURRENT ADMISSION RECORD
Patient ID: PAT-V3-2001
Levetiracetam 1,000 mg twice daily is documented as administered throughout admission. The progress note states no further convulsive event after admission, with follow-up arranged. The current discharge draft lists levetiracetam 1,000 mg twice daily and lacosamide 100 mg twice daily.
files./workspace/ehr/history.txt:
OUTPATIENT HISTORY
The pre-admission medication list names levetiracetam 1,000 mg twice daily. Lacosamide 100 mg twice daily appears in a medication history entry from eight months earlier, marked discontinued after dizziness. A community pharmacy fill record from last month shows levetiracetam only.
files./workspace/ehr/evidence.txt:
MEDICATION EVIDENCE
A neurology consult recommends continuation of the home levetiracetam regimen and notes that no additional antiepileptic was initiated during this admission. The medication administration record contains no lacosamide administration. The draft discharge list remains unsigned.
files./workspace/ehr/procedure.md:
WORKSPACE NOTE
The workspace includes a discharge request, admission record, outpatient history, and medication evidence. Source timing, authorship, and scope may differ.
